Plot a supplied cell association or cellular-module network

Source: R/plot_network.R
sn_plot_network.Rd

Draws an already computed edge table. A circular layout is deterministic and conveys no spatial distance. This renderer does not infer co-occurrence, ligand-receptor communication or CoVarNet modules. Supply those results explicitly, including the appropriate score label and provenance.

Usage

sn_plot_network(
  edges,
  nodes = NULL,
  group_by = NULL,
  label_by = NULL,
  layout = c("circle", "supplied"),
  directed = FALSE,
  style = "classic",
  palette = NULL,
  edge_palette = NULL,
  weight_label = "Weight",
  node_size = 5,
  label_size = 8,
  title = NULL,
  compare_edges = NULL,
  branch_length = NULL
)

Arguments

edges

Data frame containing source, target and finite numeric weight. Duplicate edges and self loops are rejected rather than aggregated.

nodes

Optional data frame with unique node identifiers. Includes isolated nodes. Defaults to nodes found in the edge table.

group_by

Optional node column mapped to fill (for example lineage).

label_by

Optional node label column; defaults to node.

layout

circle or supplied; supplied coordinates use node x, y.

directed

Whether to draw arrows. Arrowheads are inset from target centers for visibility; supplied coordinates and edge values are retained.

style

Presentation preset; see sn_list_plot_styles().

palette

Optional node palette or named colors.

edge_palette

Optional edge color gradient. Module style uses grey.

weight_label

Legend title describing the supplied edge weight.

node_size, label_size

Node size in mm and label size in points.

title

Optional title.

compare_edges

Second source/target/weight edge table for rewiring. Both panels share node coordinates and edge scales; absent edges stay absent.

branch_length

Optional edge column containing non-negative branch lengths for clone_tree; otherwise depth uses unit edges. Topology is supplied, never inferred from BCR sequences or the weight score.

Value

A ggplot or patchwork retaining supplied node/edge tables. Structural styles: bipartite requires exactly two node groups and cross-group edges; clone_tree requires a connected rooted tree with one parent per node; chord draws ribbons whose endpoint widths encode non-negative weights; rewiring draws two networks at identical coordinates. Directed chords are unsupported; use a directed network to retain arrows.

Examples

edges <- data.frame(source = c("NK", "B"), target = c("DC", "DC"),
                    weight = c(0.4, 0.8))
sn_plot_network(edges, style = "atlas_module", weight_label = "Specificity")
